title: Lou Rawls
summary: She remembers Rawls and their UNCF years.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Leading a band: running, choosing and keeping players

blocks.x: Bless his heart. I miss him. One of the things that stands out is when we both did one of Cannonball’s live albums. We’re – both of us are on one of Cannonball’s albums. Lou and I have always had – we always had a good rapport, good relationship, especially doing UNCF year after year after year after year after year after year. This is the first time I didn’t go, was this past year, didn’t go to UNCF. I’ve been every year for so long. And Mary Dee didn’t go either. So, they miss us.
